title: 多轮对话格式构造：messages 列表保留完整历史
code:
def build_multiturn(history):
    msgs = [{"role": "system", "content": "你是有帮助的助手。"}]
    for turn in history:
        msgs.append({"role": "user", "content": turn["q"]})
        msgs.append({"role": "assistant", "content": turn["a"]})
    return msgs

conv = build_multiturn([
    {"q": "1+1等于几？", "a": "等于2。"},
    {"q": "那它加3呢？", "a": "2+3=5。"},
])
print(len(conv))
print(conv[1]["content"], conv[2]["content"])
print(conv[-2]["content"], conv[-1]["content"])
